title: QuantFlow
description: An institutional-grade algorithmic trading system for Indian equity markets with 15+ technical indicators, multi-timeframe confluence, Kelly Criterion risk management, and Angel One SmartAPI integration.

title: GhostScanner
description: A concurrent Go-based scanner designed to identify and safely exploit complex HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE and TE.CL) vulnerabilities on edge proxy networks.

title: Linux Kernel Process Sandbox

title: MiniCPU & Assembler
